limitations: No measured or assumed indoor/outdoor temperature or humidity is a model input. Energy still varies with those unobserved conditions, so controls alone cannot establish exact physical consumption.
Room/load evolution and compressor cycling are not simulated; one-hour labels are model estimates.
Eco energy/duration anchors derive from original shorter/longer experiments, not measured next-hour energy.
Eco Gear is distinct from Eco Sensor. ESPHome IR support and firmware equivalence remain unverified.
Motor rated output is not measured electrical input; efficiency and affinity-law application are assumptions.
Numerical Turbo, Quiet, Swing, Display, Dry and new-condition effects are not verified by measured energy comparisons.
Pairwise/compound function compatibility is a conservative modeling policy unless a rule is cited explicitly.
Filter is not verified as an independently toggled energy function; it remains not applicable, not OFF.
Other device features such as Self-Clean, UV/Health, Sleep and timers require separate operating models and are outside the panel subset.
target_basis: Original research-generated one-hour reference estimates, not measured electricity. Unobserved environmental variation is retained in the original per-row targets.
